### Lyapunov's Inequality

:::{.theorem data-title="Lyapunov's Inequality"}

**Lyapunov's inequality** is a special case of [[holders-inequality]],
replacing $\lvert  X \rvert$ by $\lvert X \rvert^r$ with $r>0$ and writing
$s=rp$, which states
$$
(\mathbb{E}[\lvert X \rvert^r] )^{1/r}\leq  (\mathbb{E}[\lvert X \rvert ^s])^{1/s};\quad 0 < r < s < \infty.
$$

:::
